conflicts.why: Pajakku (2026-07-15) cites Kepgub 450/2026: 50% off for KTP DKI holders, price up to Rp500 juta. DDTC (2025-09-26) cites Kepgub 840/2025 with a second 75% tier up to Rp1 miliar. decisions.summary: Minimum down payment is a per-bank setting the owner enters locally. Default: 5%. A 0% DP is used only for a bank the owner marks as offering it.
decisions.rationale: Only banks meeting BI bad-loan criteria may lend 100% until 31 Dec 2027; under PADG 30/2025 other banks stay at 95% LTV for landed houses above 70 m², so 5% is the safe default. Per U-01 [cite: regulation · https://www.bi.go.id/id/publikasi/peraturan/Pages/PADG_302025.aspx · upd 2025-12-24 · acc 2026-11-26 · primary · live · amend-check 2026-11-26]

decisions.summary: The upfront-cash estimate per house = DP + BPHTB + bank fees + notary and insurance estimates. BPHTB = 5% × (price − NPOPTKP). NPOPTKP is an area setting: South Jakarta default Rp250 juta; Depok has no default, so Depok houses show "BPHTB belum lengkap" until the owner enters the figure. Bank fee defaults (provisi 1%, administration, appraisal) are editable.
decisions.rationale: BPHTB and bank fees are cash due at or before the akad, and the owner asked for upfront cash per house (D-008). Per U-04 [cite: regulation · https://ortax.org/ketentuan-bphtb-dan-cara-menghitung · pub 2023-04-28 · acc 2026-11-26 · amend-check 2026-11-26], U-15 [cite: regulation · https://news.ddtc.co.id/berita/daerah/1823579/beli-atau-dapat-warisan-properti-di-jakarta-pahami-kewajiban-pajaknya · pub 2026-10-26 · acc 2026-11-26 · amend-check 2026-11-26], U-05 [cite: price · https://www.bca.co.id/id/individu/produk/pinjaman/kpr/kpr-first · n.d. · acc 2026-11-26 · primary · live]. The Depok gap (U-16) is handled by leaving no default, not by assuming a value.

decisions.summary: The tool applies no first-home BPHTB relief automatically; the estimate is the conservative, full BPHTB.
decisions.rationale: Sources disagree on the current DKI relief scheme, and eligibility depends on the owner's KTP, which stays off this conversation. A conservative estimate cannot hide a cash shortfall. Per U-17 [cite: regulation · https://pajakku.com/artikel/beli-rumah-pertama-di-jakarta-bisa-hemat-bphtb-hingga-50 · upd 2026-07-15 · acc 2026-11-26 · amend-check 2026-11-26]

decisions.summary: The tool does not check credit history. The shortlist page and CSV carry a fixed note that bank approval also depends on the owner's SLIK OJK record.
decisions.rationale: Banks check SLIK; larger paylater or online-loan arrears can block a KPR even when the numbers fit. Per U-10 [cite: regulation · https://www.fortuneidn.com/finance/slik-dilonggarkan-nasabah-nunggak-di-bawah-rp1-juta-masih-bisa-ambil-kpr-subsidi-00-ccw2k-15tp04 · pub 2026-04-14 · acc 2026-11-26 · amend-check 2026-11-26]

decisions.rationale: S2 hard-rule check against the S1 platform shape: a local web app has no app-store or hosting account. Shown here for correction.

sources.title: Preventing DNS Rebinding Attacks
DNS rebinding check

decisions.summary: The local server listens only on 127.0.0.1 and rejects (HTTP 400) any request whose Host header is not localhost or 127.0.0.1 with the app port; no other device on the Wi-Fi and no website can read the profile.
decisions.rationale: Binding to loopback alone does not stop DNS rebinding from a website open in the same browser. Per U-18 [cite: general · https://github.com/nccgroup/singularity/wiki/Preventing-DNS-Rebinding-Attacks · n.d. · acc 2026-11-26] [cite: general · https://docs.gitlab.com/user/application_security/api_security_testing/checks/dns_rebinding_check/ · n.d. · acc 2026-11-26]

decisions.summary: The app makes no network calls of its own: no analytics, no error reporting, no fonts or scripts from the internet, no external maps or AI services; it works with the internet off. Listing links in the CSV open only when the owner clicks them.
decisions.rationale: Hard constraint D-006: income and savings never leave the laptop; anything loaded from the internet could carry data out. No money flows in the app (D-014) and there is no login (D-007).

decisions.summary: No privacy policy, consent screen or data-protection officer is planned: the tool processes the owner’s own data for personal, household use only. If it is ever shared with other people or used commercially, this decision is reopened.
decisions.rationale: UU PDP Art. 2(2) excludes processing by an individual for personal or household purposes. Per U-02 [cite: regulation · https://jdih.komdigi.go.id/produk_hukum/view/id/832/t/undangundang%2Bnomor%2B27%2Btahun%2B2022 · pub 2022-10-17 · acc 2026-11-26 · primary · live · amend-check 2026-11-26] [cite: regulation · https://www.hukumonline.com/berita/a/mk--uu-pdp-lindungi-pemrosesan-data-privat-bersifat-nonkomersil-lt6454b8bc84511/?page=all · pub 2023-05-05 · acc 2026-11-26 · amend-check 2026-11-26]

decisions.summary: Protection at rest relies on Linux full-disk encryption (LUKS); the app adds no password of its own. An "Ekspor cadangan" button writes all app data to one file the owner stores where they choose; an import restores it. The owner does not know whether disk encryption is on, so the handover includes a one-line check (lsblk -f shows crypto_LUKS) and the app shows a reminder on the Profile page until the owner ticks "sudah dicek".
decisions.rationale: Answered by the owner's delegated test agent (S3.q2). An app password that is forgotten loses the data; nothing is backed up unless something does it on purpose.

payload.q: Cara menghapus data: a. Hapus semua data; b. hapus per file impor; c. keduanya.

decisions.summary: Erasure: "Hapus semua data", delete per import file, and delete the financial profile alone; each needs the owner to type HAPUS. Deleted data is removed from the app's storage file, not hidden. Exported backup files are the owner's to delete.
decisions.rationale: Answered by the owner's delegated test agent (S3.q3).

payload.q: (Konfirmasi keputusan) D-021 sampai D-023 — koreksi kalau ada yang tidak sesuai.
payload.a: D-021 sampai D-023 disetujui.

decisions.summary: Imported CSV is untrusted text: every cell is shown as plain text (never as HTML); only http/https listing links become clickable; files over 5 MB or 2,000 rows are refused with a plain message; in the exported shortlist CSV, cells starting with = + - @ are prefixed with an apostrophe so a spreadsheet cannot run them as formulas.
decisions.rationale: Threat-modeling pass (tampering): listing text is copied from public sites and may carry markup, javascript: links or spreadsheet formulas. Limits sit well above the busy month of 400–600 listings (D-018).

decisions.summary: Every request that changes data (import, save profile, delete) must come from the app's own page: the server checks that the Origin header is the app's localhost address and rejects anything else. A website cannot trigger "Hapus semua data" or overwrite the profile.
decisions.rationale: Threat-modeling pass (tampering): a hidden form on any website can send a request to localhost with a valid Host header, so the Host check of D-021 alone does not stop it.

decisions.summary: Instead of a legal privacy policy (not needed per D-023), the app has a short "Data & privasi" page in plain Indonesian: what is stored, that it never leaves the laptop, where the storage file lives, how to back up, and how to delete.
decisions.rationale: Privacy-policy rule: the product keeps personal data. No store or consent screen applies, so an in-app explanation meets the purpose.
